**Finding: LD — compliant (preferred position met).**

No Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum fee exists anywhere in the Agreement:

- **Section 4 / Exhibit B (Pricing, Revenue Sharing) / Section 17 (Payment Terms)** — only ordinary consideration: license fees on Software Acceptance, annual maintenance and support fees, MarketSite.net access fees, implementation fees on a time-and-materials basis "not to exceed [*]", and reciprocal revenue-share payments.
- **Section 11 (Term and Termination)** — breach/insolvency termination and 30-day non-renewal notice only; no termination charge. Post-termination payments under 11.3 are continuing fees for continued Customer use and continued Commerce One support, i.e. consideration, not a stipulated sum.
- **Section 4.4 (Audit)** — reciprocal shortfall/overpayment true-up plus reimbursement of actual examination cost on a >5% underpayment; a cost-recovery mechanic, not a penalty.
- **Sections 3.x and 7** — termination money runs to us (refund of fees paid / prepaid fees), which is compliant by definition.
- **Section 9** — a mutual cap and consequential-damages exclusion; no stipulated damages formula.

Accordingly this sits at the **preferred** level (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), so we have proposed no redline.
